Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#1 language — the double gift walked: attract + pulse pointer (access draws the speaker in); the language sequence runs access → measure → ℘ (the same acquisition, first opening then installing); the speaker's ◉ sequence brightens with acquired capacity then dims under the standard. Duration 12.
#2 gaze — THE 3D SCENE. z is the carriage's depth: the schemata at the visible body nearest (z +0.4), the carriage around him (z 0), the hail from the far end (z −0.5) — the space left around him part of the event, literally. The hail's sequence grows ! from smile-small grey to fear-large red; the schema sequence walks body-schema → epidermal schema (pale to wounded red). Repel + shove pointer (the interruption). Duration 13.
#3 mask — the inward turn staged as a morph: the legible square shrinks and pales, then becomes ≡ — the outer form become the inward measure; vortex + pulse pointer (the turning inward); near-still field (dispersion 0.05) — the administration is quiet. Duration 12.
#4 recognition — line layout: the participants faced; auto-demand, a sine LFO on circulation (reciprocity breathing); the ◉◉ pair brightens as the terms question 'who determines the terms?' appears beside the scales; attract + implode pointer (the demand gathers). Duration 14.
#5→0 return — the mask ring re-lights gold and settles (returned to the scene that made it meaningful, its force visible, its finality refused); attract at 0.25, the gentlest hold — the person remains available to answer. Duration 15, the longest beat.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: the journey opens with a speaker drawn into a language that grants access while installing a measure — his ◉ dimming through its own sequence — and closes at the gentlest hold with the mask returned to its scene: the capacity acquired at #1 is retained (the record's indispensable difference between capacity and valuation), but the hold is no longer the measure's. The ◉ dimmed at #1 stands at #4 as ◉◉ — recognition needing two — with ≠ naming what made it unequal and the scales' question transferring the weight from self-administration to the terms themselves. The journey's pointer arc runs from the language's invitation (0.4) through the hail's shove (0.5) and the demand's implode (0.45) to the answer's open 0.25.
Human-amplified staging: the four proposed comparisons keep their unratified standing and A27 stays human-amplified: no, verbatim in the #5→0 body; the cross-whole neighbours are named with their differences in the occ block. Mythemic verbs only: the scenes demonstrate the relation between image, bearer and the conditions of its power; no general formula substitutes for the historically produced sequence.
Automation: auto-demand (#4, field.params.circulation sine — the reciprocal demand breathing), tied to the record's move. Durations 12–15 and transitions 1.3–2.2: recognition and return held longest.

Colour journey: institutional grey held across language and hail (stillness on the pair) → porcelain light held across mask and recognition (stillness on the pair) → the open page of the return. glyph_rationales.the speaker — acquiring real capacity, h: the figure drawn speaking with sound-lines — the Antillean whose acquired French is heard through the prestige it signals, not only what it says.
glyph_rationales.the language — access and inherited judg: the drawn ruler with gradations — metropolitan French as a graduated scale: real participation granted through a hierarchy he did not institute.
glyph_rationales.the measure turned inward — then applied: the square — the standard become frame: self-evaluation administered from inside, then turned on those whose speech fails it.
glyph_rationales.the train carriage — the practical bodil: the drawn compartment with its two figures — the public world of habitual movement in which the hail lands.
glyph_rationales.the hail — the smile becoming the child': the single exclamation — 'Look, a Negro!': the moment the surrounding space organises itself against the body it names.
glyph_rationales.!: the hail itself — 'Look, a Negro!': the shout through which the surrounding space reorganises around the body it names.
glyph_rationales.the body-schema giving way to the epider: two drawn states — the whole bodily figure, then a hollow contour: lived possibility collapsing onto the surface the gaze imposes.
glyph_rationales.the white mask — legible form, opened pa: the drawn mask with its eye-holes — the socially legible form that grants a hearing while carrying the standard that grants it.
glyph_rationales.beneath it no untouched essence — anothe: the faint second contour — peeling the mask reveals another socially formed surface, not a private essence untouched by the relation.
glyph_rationales.≡: the inward measure — anticipation, editing, the unapproved response as fault.
glyph_rationales.⚖: the scales — the mask's double edge, access reinforcing the measure admission depended on; and the revised terms of recognition.
glyph_rationales.recognition — two participants, each req: two drawn profiles facing — the reciprocal demand: each self requires the other's confirming act.
glyph_rationales.the white standard — the social third go: the square above both heads — Adler's rivalry relocated: both comparers judged under a third term neither instituted.
glyph_rationales.≠: the unequal history — one participant inheriting an authority to classify that the other lacks.
glyph_rationales.the mask returned to the scene that made: the wide ring — the mask brought back to the language, gaze and recognition relations that give it force.
glyph_rationales.the door held open — the person exceeds: the drawn open door — the future-facing freedom that lets the person take up history through present choices.
glyph_rationales.4×: the four proposed comparisons held deliberately unratified — adaptive interface, category before encounter, co-internality, idol and image.
glyph_rationales.◌: the cross-whole neighbours held at distance — Number Six, Apollo–Daphne, the moving mirror, Attica; distinct worlds, distinct mechanisms.
glyph_rationales.one centre — inward, answerable, not abs: the first disc — an inward centre whose answering capacity is real.
glyph_rationales.another centre — not exhausted by the fi: the second disc, set apart — the other whose reality no prior image exhausts (unity without possession).

note: DEPTH — two scenes stand in 3d and z separates what the record refuses to merge: #3 mask holds the white mask nearest (z +0.28), the '≡' of equivalent measure and the scale at mid-depth, and the person beneath at z −0.24 — the surface the world sees in front of, never instead of, whoever bears it; #4 recognition keeps the two participants and the white standard at separated depths — the relation that distributes recognition is not one plane.

MORPH — #3 and #4 morph on the authored quantumInterference trajectory (drive smooth, law theta 0.05/0.08): the imposed image and the person it is imposed on held as two patterns in interference — each real, neither dissolving into the other; beneath the mask no untouched essence, and no fusion either.

ALIVE — three physics profiles: language and gaze as ink (material ink — the word that opens access, the label that fixes, roundness 0.45, softness 0.12) held identical across the two dark scenes — the journey's rest; the mask block's pale measured field (opacity 0.88, halo 0.06, zConfinement 0.7); the return's softened answerable field (roundness 0.98, softness 0.25, halo 0.1).
